text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"\"therefore,\" \"firstly,\" \"secondly,\" \"Lastly,\" \"In conclusion\"","quality":"organization","description":"The essay uses a clearer overall structure with signposted points and a conclusion that helps guide the reader through the argument."},{"evidence":"\"specialized to a topic of interest\" \"spark their interest\" \"spread their knowledge\"","quality":"word choice","description":"It more often uses precise and academic vocabulary to express ideas in a more controlled way."},{"evidence":"\"lense\" \"over all\" \"refering\" \"incentify\"","quality":"spelling control","description":"It has fewer and less disruptive spelling problems than the other essay, which helps readability."},{"evidence":"\"will allow for every student to specify the project on his or her interests\"","quality":"sentence control","description":"Its sentences are more consistently formed and easier to follow, with fewer run-on or awkwardly joined clauses."},{"evidence":"\"most middle schools conduct science fairs\"","quality":"development of examples","description":"It supports claims with a more concrete and relevant example that is extended to explain the point."}]}
